name: wrait-openapi-tooling
description: Tooling for generating the Flutter backend client from OpenAPI.

scripts.generate:backend-api: openapi-generator-cli generate -g dart-dio -i api/wrait-backend.yaml -c tool/openapi-generator/backend-api-config.yaml -o tool/openapi-generator/output/backend_api && cd tool/openapi-generator/output/backend_api && dart pub get && dart run build_runner build && dart fix --apply --code=unused_import,duplicate_import
